label: Fixed modal accessibility and truth admit every interior event probability
description: Corollary and transcription (instance of c3f76aea): a direct instance of the shared interior-mass statement at the accessible-world subtype, adding the Kripke typing and no new mathematics. Restated from the never-compiled draft: for a probability measure, p : ENNReal with 0 < p < 1 and measure s = p is equivalent to an InteriorRate p with real measure s = p, so the value form is unchanged; the hypotheses were weakened from infinite to nonempty truth classes, so the new statement implies the draft's.
